title: Rent or licence fee and due date

source.quote: The Licensee shall pay a monthly licence fee of Rs. 45,000/- on or before the 5th day of each month.

plain_explanation.text: The agreement says the monthly fee is Rs. 45,000. This payment must be made by the 5th day of every month.

citations.quote: The Licensee shall pay a monthly licence fee of Rs. 45,000/- on or before the 5th day of each month.

interpretations.text: The agreement states that the monthly licence fee is Rs. 45,000 and it is due on or before the 5th day of each month (C3).
